title: 第8章
content:
江南市的午后，蝉鸣像被拧到最大音量的收音机，在香樟树枝叶间此起彼伏。篮球场的塑胶地面被晒得发软，泛起一层油亮的光，反射着高三（7）班女生们此起彼伏的尖叫——不是为了灌篮，而是为了赵天雷那双踩在限量版aj上的脚，此刻正以一种嚣张的姿态，横跨在林宇面前的水泥分界线上。“林宇，敢不敢接招？”赵天雷晃了晃手里的牛皮纸信封，百元大钞的边角从封口探出来，像挑逗猎物的红布。他身后站着三个跟班，其中一个正用手机直播，镜头刻意扫过林宇洗得发白的校服袖口，又迅速切回赵天雷嘴角那抹不容错辨的轻蔑。林宇刚跑完三千米体能测试，汗水顺着额角滑进眼窝，刺得他眯起眼。他弯腰撑着膝盖喘气，余光瞥见苏清影抱着两瓶冰镇矿泉水穿过人群，白色的裙摆被风扬起时，露出纤细脚踝上若隐若现的红绳——那是上周他在古玩市场帮她淘到的，据说是用三星堆遗址附近的桑蚕丝织成。“没空，”林宇直起身，接过苏清影递来的水，拧开瓶盖时，瓶口凝结的水珠滴在手腕上，“下午还有物理模拟考。”“呵，模拟考？”赵天雷嗤笑一声，往前逼近半步。他身上的古龙水味混合着阳光晒出的汗气，形成一种极具压迫感的气息，“我这题，比你那破模拟考有意思多了。看见没？”他扬了扬信封，“里面三道题，你要能在午休结束前答出来，我赵天雷明天升旗台喊你三声爹，外加这沓钱全归你。”围观的人群发出低低的惊呼。那沓钞票厚得像块砖，至少有五位数。“如果我答不出来呢？”林宇拧瓶盖的手顿了顿，矿泉水瓶壁上的冷凝水正沿着指缝往下淌。“答不出来？”赵天雷像是听到了什么笑话，夸张地张开双臂，“那你就离苏清影远点，以后见了我绕着走。怎么样，敢不敢赌？”他说话时，袖口不经意间滑落，露出一截军用通讯器的黑色边缘，上面闪烁的红光快得像摩斯密码。林宇想起早自习时瞥见的鞋底碎纸，“绝密·六代机”那几个字像针一样扎在记忆里。苏清影轻轻拽了拽林宇的袖子，冰凉的指尖隔着布料传来温度：“别理他，快考试了。”她的声音很轻，却带着不易察觉的紧张，手里另一瓶水的瓶身布满水珠，那些水珠汇聚成的纹路，竟和林宇昨晚在《自然》子刊上看到的某种纳米结构示意图惊人地相似。林宇的心猛地一跳。他知道赵天雷嫉妒自己和苏清影走得近，但这次的赌约透着一股不同寻常的狠劲。赵天雷家族在军方的势力他略有耳闻，难道那些碎纸……“怎么？不敢了？”赵天雷见林宇迟疑，语气更带挑衅，“我就知道，穷鬼家的孩子，也就配埋头啃书本，真遇到点‘高级货’就傻眼了。”这句话像根刺，扎进林宇心里。他不是在乎钱，也不是怕赵天雷，而是突然意识到，这个赌约可能不止是意气之争。他抬眼看向赵天雷，对方瞳孔里闪烁着一种近乎疯狂的期待，仿佛笃定他一定会接下这个陷阱。“好，我赌。”林宇的声音不大，却清晰地穿过嘈杂的人声。苏清影的手猛地收紧，矿泉水瓶发出轻微的挤压声。赵天雷脸上的笑容瞬间凝固了一瞬，随即又变得更加灿烂：“够种！来人，把‘题’给林同学呈上！”跟班嬉皮笑脸地递过信封。林宇接过来时，指尖触到纸张边缘异常光滑的质感——那是被化学试剂擦拭过的痕迹。他不动声色地翻开，里面只有一张a4纸，正面印着三组复杂的流体力学公式，配图是一个扭曲的机翼轮廓，尾翼部分的夹角标注着奇怪的角度：114.5°。“这是……附加题？”林宇皱起眉。这些公式远超高考范围，更像是某种航空动力学的理论模型，但推导过程中有几处明显的逻辑断层，像是故意留下的破绽。“怎么？看不懂？”赵天雷抱着胳膊，一副胜券在握的样子，“我就说嘛，给你本天书也白搭……”他的话没说完，林宇突然伸出手指，点在公式末端的一个参数上：“这里，雷诺数的计算有误。而且这个机翼模型，”他顿了顿，目光扫过扭曲的翼尖，“如果按照这个角度设计，亚音速巡航时升力系数会骤降，根本不可能稳定飞行。”空气瞬间安静下来。赵天雷脸上的笑容僵住了，连直播的跟班都忘了操作手机。苏清影惊讶地看着林宇，她知道林宇物理好，但没想到他能一眼看出这些连老师都未必涉及的问题。“你……你胡说什么！”赵天雷的声音有些发虚，“这是我找的奥赛题，你懂个屁！”林宇没理他，目光落在纸边被擦改的水印位置。虽然痕迹很淡，但在阳光下仍能看到“科学院内部资料”的模糊字样。他心里一沉，果然和那些碎纸有关。赵天雷这是想干什么？用国家机密来设局？“是不是胡说，算一下就知道了。”林宇抬起头，眼神平静却带着一股锐利，“不过我有个条件。”“你还想提条件？”赵天雷像是被戳中了痛处，语气又变得嚣张起来。“如果我答出来，”林宇的目光扫过赵天雷，最后落在他袖口的通讯器上，“你要告诉我，这道题的真正来源。”赵天雷的瞳孔猛地一缩。周围的空气仿佛凝固了，蝉鸣声都变得遥远。他没想到林宇会提出这样的条件，这已经超出了一个高中生的正常反应。难道这小子发现了什么？“你管那么多干嘛！”赵天雷强作镇定，“答出来自然告诉你，答不出来就给我滚远点！”就在这时，苏清影突然往前一步，将另一瓶水递给赵天雷：“赵同学，天气热，喝口水吧。”她的表情很自然，笑容甜美，但递水的动作却让瓶盖不小心碰到了赵天雷的手腕。“滚！谁要喝你的水！”赵天雷像是被烫到一样猛地挥手，矿泉水瓶摔在地上，溅起的水花打湿了林宇的裤脚。林宇弯腰去捡瓶子，指尖触到冰凉的瓶身时，突然愣住了。瓶身上的冷凝水已经汇成几道水流，其中一道恰好沿着瓶身的弧度蜿蜒而下，在阳光下折射出奇异的光泽——那形状，分明就是纸上机翼模型的侧视图，而水流交汇的节点，正是他刚才指出的那个错误参数位置。怎么会这么巧？林宇猛地抬起头，看向苏清影。女孩的眼神清澈，脸上带着恰到好处的尴尬：“对不起，我不是故意的……”但林宇注意到，她垂在身侧的手指，正快速地敲击着裙摆，那节奏，像是在输入某种代码。

“少废话！到底答不答？”赵天雷不耐烦地催促，通讯器的红光闪烁得更快了，几乎变成了常亮。林宇深吸一口气，将矿泉水瓶放在地上。阳光照在a4纸上，那些复杂的公式仿佛活了过来，在他眼中逐渐分解、重组。他想起早自习时赵天雷鞋底的碎纸，想起王教授讲课时偶尔走神提到的“应龙计划”，想起苏清影脚踝上那根来自三星堆的红绳……一个荒谬却又似乎合理的念头在他脑中形成。“可以。”林宇拿起那张纸，指尖在被擦改的水印处轻轻划过，“不过我需要笔和纸。”赵天雷像是松了口气，示意跟班去拿。林宇接过笔和草稿本，目光再次落在那组流体力学公式上。这一次，他没有去看那些表面的推导，而是试图寻找隐藏在错误之下的真相。突然，他发现其中一个变量的下标写法很奇怪，像是某种特定的编码。他尝试着将字母替换成数字，再按照矩阵排列——“等等！”苏清影突然轻呼一声，“林宇，你的手……”林宇低头，看到自己握着笔的手指正在不受控制地颤抖，笔尖在草稿纸上画出一个扭曲的符号，那符号的形状，竟和纸上机翼模型的尾翼夹角一模一样：114.5°。与此同时，赵天雷袖口的通讯器突然发出一声极轻微的蜂鸣，红光闪烁了三下，然后熄灭了。赵天雷的脸色瞬间变得惨白。他猛地转身，对着直播的跟班吼道：“关了！快关了！”但已经晚了。林宇看着草稿纸上那个自动生成的符号，脑海中突然响起一个极其微弱的机械音，快得像错觉：“……检测到异常科技参数……正在扫描……”他猛地抬头，看向赵天雷。对方眼神慌乱，正试图抢夺他手中的纸张。而苏清影不知何时已经退到了人群边缘，她看着林宇，眼神里充满了复杂的情绪，有担忧，有急切，还有一丝难以察觉的……期待。“想抢？”林宇手腕一翻，将纸张护在身后，“赵天雷，你还没告诉我，这题到底是从哪来的？”赵天雷的脸涨得通红，像是被逼到绝境的野兽。他环顾四周，发现围观的同学都在用异样的眼光看着他，直播的手机还在对着他。他突然像是下定了决心，冷笑一声：“好，我告诉你！这题……”他的话没说完，篮球场入口处突然传来一阵急促的脚步声。几个穿着便衣的成年人快步走来，为首的那个亮出证件，声音低沉而有力：“我们是国安局的。赵天雷，你涉嫌泄露国家机密，请跟我们走一趟。”人群瞬间炸开了锅。赵天雷脸色煞白，踉跄着后退一步，指着林宇，声音都在发抖：“是他！是林宇！他才是……”“是不是，我们会调查清楚。”国安局的人上前一步，语气不容置疑，“现在，请你配合我们的工作。”混乱中，林宇低头看向手中的a4纸。阳光透过纸张，在他手背上投下奇异的光影。那些复杂的公式和扭曲的机翼轮廓，此刻在他眼中似乎正在发生某种奇妙的变化，仿佛有一层肉眼看不见的数据流正在上面流淌。他又想起那个微弱的机械音，想起苏清影递水时冷凝水的纹路，想起赵天雷通讯器闪烁的红光……这一切，真的只是一个富二代的嫉妒陷阱吗？苏清影不知何时又走到了他身边，轻轻拽了拽他的衣角，声音低得只有两人能听见：“林宇，快跑。”林宇猛地看向她。女孩的眼睛里映着午后的阳光，清澈得像一汪深潭，却又藏着他看不懂的惊涛骇浪。“跑？”林宇皱眉，“为什么？”苏清影咬了咬嘴唇，目光快速扫过正在被带走的赵天雷，又看向远处香樟树上正在落下的蝉蜕，声音压得更低：“因为……他们来了。”林宇顺着她的目光看去，只见香樟树的阴影里，不知何时多了几个穿着校服、却带着明显不属于学生气质的身影。他们站在那里，看似在围观，眼神却像鹰隼一样锐利，正不动声色地打量着他，以及他手中的那张a4纸。机械音再次在脑海中响起，这一次清晰了一些：“……科技推演系统绑定中……检测到宿主面临威胁……启动初级防御模式……”林宇的心脏猛地一缩。他握紧了手中的纸，指尖传来纸张冰凉的触感，却又隐隐带着一丝微不可察的震动。赌约的陷阱，似乎才刚刚开始。而他，已经没有退路了。
content_en:
In the afternoon in Jiangnan City, cicadas chirp like a radio turned to maximum volume, one after another among the camphor branches and leaves.The plastic floor of the basketball court was softened by the sun, with a layer of oily light, reflecting the screams of the girls in Class 7 of Senior High School - not for dunks, but for Zhao Tianlei's feet on the limited edition AJ, which was straddling the cement dividing line in front of Lin Yu in an arrogant manner."Lin Yu, do you dare to accept the move?" Zhao Tianlei shook the kraft paper envelope in his hand, and the corners of the hundred-dollar bill poked out from the seal, like a red cloth teasing prey.There were three followers standing behind him, one of whom was live broadcasting on his mobile phone. The camera deliberately glanced at Lin Yu's washed-white cuffs of his school uniform, and then quickly cut back to the unmistakable contempt on the corner of Zhao Tianlei's mouth.Lin Yu had just finished running a three-thousand-meter physical fitness test. Sweat slid down his forehead and into his eye sockets, causing him to squint.He bent over and propped up his knees to catch his breath. From the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of Su Qingying walking through the crowd holding two bottles of ice-cold mineral water. When her white skirt was lifted by the wind, the looming red rope on her slender ankles was revealed - which he had found for her at the antique market last week. It was said to be woven from mulberry silk near the Sanxingdui ruins."No time," Lin Yu straightened up and took the water from Su Qingying. When he unscrewed the bottle cap, water droplets condensed on the mouth of the bottle dripped on his wrist. "There will be a physics simulation test in the afternoon." "Huh, a simulation test?" Zhao Tianlei sneered and took half a step forward.The cologne smell on his body mixed with the sweat from the sun, forming a very oppressive atmosphere. "My questions are much more interesting than your crappy mock test. Do you see?" He raised the envelope, "There are three questions in it. If you can answer them before the end of the lunch break, I, Zhao Tianlei, will call you daddy three times at the flag-raising stage tomorrow, and all this money will be yours." The crowd of onlookers let out low exclamations.The stack of banknotes was as thick as a brick and contained at least five figures."What if I can't answer the answer?" Lin Yu's hand twisting the bottle cap paused, and the condensation water on the wall of the mineral water bottle was dripping down between his fingers."Can't answer?" Zhao Tianlei opened his arms exaggeratedly as if he heard some joke, "Then you stay away from Su Qingying, and walk around me when you see her in the future. How about it, do you dare to take a gamble?" As he spoke, his cuffs inadvertently slipped down, revealing the black edge of a military communicator. The red light flashing on it was as fast as Morse code.Lin Yu thought of the shredded paper soles he had glimpsed during his early self-study, and the words "Top Secret Sixth Generation Machine" were stuck in his memory like needles.Su Qingying gently tugged on Lin Yu's sleeve, and her cold fingertips felt warm through the fabric: "Ignore him, the exam is about to take place." Her voice was very soft, but with an imperceptible nervousness. The body of another bottle of water in her hand was covered with water droplets, and the lines formed by those water droplets were surprisingly similar to the schematic diagram of a certain nanostructure that Lin Yu saw in the "Nature" sub-issue last night.Lin Yu's heart skipped a beat.He knew that Zhao Tianlei was jealous that he and Su Qingying were close, but this bet showed an unusual cruelty.He had heard a little bit about the power of the Zhao Tianlei family in the military. Could it be that those scraps of paper... "What? Don't you dare?" Seeing Lin Yu's hesitation, Zhao Tianlei's tone became more provocative, "I know that children from poor families can only bury their heads in books. If they encounter some 'high-end goods', they will be dumbfounded." This sentence was like a thorn in Lin Yu's heart.He didn't care about money, nor was he afraid of Zhao Tianlei, but he suddenly realized that this bet might be more than just a battle of spirits.He raised his eyes and looked at Zhao Tianlei. There was an almost crazy expectation in his pupils, as if he was sure that he would accept this trap."Okay, I'll bet." Lin Yu's voice was not loud, but it cut through the noisy crowd clearly.Su Qingying's hand tightened suddenly, and the mineral water bottle made a slight squeezing sound.The smile on Zhao Tianlei's face froze for a moment, and then became even brighter: "That's enough! Come here, give the 'question' to Classmate Lin!" The follower handed over the envelope with a playful smile.When Lin Yu took it over, his fingertips touched the unusually smooth texture on the edge of the paper - traces of it being wiped by chemical reagents.He opened it calmly, and there was only an A4 paper inside. Three sets of complex fluid dynamics formulas were printed on the front. The picture showed a twisted wing outline, and the angle between the tail part and the tail was marked with a strange angle: 114.5°."Is this... an additional question?" Lin Yu frowned.These formulas are far beyond the scope of the college entrance examination and are more like some kind of theoretical model of aerodynamics. However, there are several obvious logical gaps in the derivation process, which seem to be intentional flaws."What? Can't you understand?" Zhao Tianlei crossed his arms and looked like he had a chance to win. "Let me tell you, giving you this book is useless..." Before he could finish his words, Lin Yu suddenly stretched out his finger and clicked on a parameter at the end of the formula: "Here, Lei"The calculation of the number is wrong. And this wing model," he paused and glanced at the twisted wing tips, "if it is designed at this angle, the lift coefficient will drop sharply during subsonic cruise, and it will be impossible to fly stably."The air suddenly became quiet.The smile on Zhao Tianlei's face froze, and even the live broadcast attendant forgot to use his mobile phone.Su Qingying looked at Lin Yu in surprise. She knew that Lin Yu was good at physics, but she didn't expect him to be able to see at a glance these problems that even teachers may not be involved in."You... what are you talking nonsense!" Zhao Tianlei's voice was a little weak, "This is the Olympiad question I asked for, you know nothing!" Lin Yu ignored him, and his eyes fell on the erased watermark on the edge of the paper.Although the traces are very faint, the vague words "Internal Information of the Academy of Sciences" can still be seen in the sunlight.His heart sank, and it really had something to do with those shredded papers.What does Zhao Tianlei want to do?Using state secrets to set up a trap?"Whether it's nonsense or not, just do the math and you'll know." Lin Yu raised his head, his eyes calm but sharp, "But I have a condition." "You still want to make a condition?" Zhao Tianlei seemed to have been hit in a sore spot, and his tone became arrogant again."If I answer it," Lin Yu glanced at Zhao Tianlei, and finally landed on the communicator on his sleeve, "you have to tell me the true origin of this question." Zhao Tianlei's pupils shrank suddenly.The surrounding air seemed to freeze, and the chirping of cicadas became distant.He didn't expect that Lin Yu would put forward such a condition, which was beyond the normal reaction of a high school student.Did this kid discover something?"Why do you care so much!" Zhao Tianlei tried to calm down, "I'll tell you the answer naturally. If you can't answer it, get away from me!" At this moment, Su Qingying suddenly took a step forward and handed another bottle of water to Zhao Tianlei: "Classmate Zhao, it's hot, please drink some water." Her expression was natural and her smile was sweet, but the bottle cap accidentally touched Zhao Tianlei's wrist while passing the water."Go away! Who wants to drink your water!" Zhao Tianlei waved his hands violently as if he was burned. The mineral water bottle fell to the ground, and the splash wet Lin Yu's trousers.Lin Yu bent down to pick up the bottle. When his fingertips touched the cold bottle, he was suddenly stunned.The condensed water on the bottle has merged into several streams of water, one of which snakes down exactly along the curvature of the bottle, reflecting a strange luster in the sunlight - that shape is clearly the side view of the wing model on paper, and the node where the water flows meet is exactly the wrong parameter position he pointed out just now.How could it be such a coincidence?Lin Yu suddenly raised his head and looked at Su Qingying.The girl's eyes were clear, with just the right amount of embarrassment on her face: "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to..." But Lin Yu noticed that her fingers hanging by her side were tapping the hem of her skirt rapidly, with a rhythm that seemed to be inputting some kind of code.

"Stop talking nonsense! Do you want to answer or not?" Zhao Tianlei urged impatiently. The red light of the communicator flashed faster, almost turning into a constant light.Lin Yu took a deep breath and placed the mineral water bottle on the ground.The sunlight shone on the A4 paper, and those complicated formulas seemed to come alive, gradually decomposing and reorganizing in his eyes.He remembered the shredded paper on the soles of Zhao Tianlei's shoes during morning self-study, the "Yinglong Project" that Professor Wang occasionally mentioned in a distracted lecture, and the red rope from Sanxingdui on Su Qingying's ankle... A ridiculous but seemingly reasonable idea formed in his mind."Okay." Lin Yu picked up the paper and lightly traced the erased watermark with his fingertips. "But I need a pen and paper." Zhao Tianlei seemed to be relieved and motioned to the follower to get it.Lin Yu took the pen and draft book, and his eyes fell on the set of fluid mechanics formulas again.This time, he did not look at the superficial derivation, but tried to find the truth hidden under the error.Suddenly, he found that the subscript of one of the variables was written in a strange way, like a specific encoding.He tried replacing the letters with numbers and arranging them according to the matrix - "Wait!" Su Qingying suddenly whispered, "Lin Yu, your hand..." Lin Yu lowered his head and saw that his fingers holding the pen were shaking uncontrollably. The tip of the pen drew a twisted symbol on the draft paper. The shape of the symbol was exactly the same as the angle of the tail of the wing model on the paper: 114.5°.At the same time, the communicator on Zhao Tianlei's cuff suddenly emitted a very slight beep, the red light flashed three times, and then went out.Zhao Tianlei's face instantly turned pale.He turned around suddenly and shouted to the live broadcast attendant: "Turn it off! Turn it off soon!" But it was already too late.Lin Yu looked at the automatically generated symbol on the draft paper, and an extremely weak mechanical sound suddenly sounded in his mind, as fast as an illusion: "...abnormal technological parameters detected...scanning..." He raised his head suddenly and looked at Zhao Tianlei.The other party's eyes were panicked and he was trying to snatch the paper in his hand.Su Qingying had retreated to the edge of the crowd at some point. She looked at Lin Yu, her eyes full of complex emotions, including worry, eagerness, and an imperceptible...expectation."Want to grab it?" Lin Yu flipped his wrist and protected the paper behind his back, "Zhao Tianlei, you haven't told me yet, where did this question come from?" Zhao Tianlei's face turned red, like a beast that was cornered.He looked around and found that the classmates who were watching were looking at him strangely, and the live broadcast mobile phone was still facing him.He suddenly seemed to have made up his mind and sneered: "Okay, I'll tell you! This question..." Before he could finish his words, there was a sudden rush of footsteps at the entrance of the basketball court.Several adults in plain clothes walked over quickly. The leader showed his ID and said in a low and powerful voice: "We are from the National Security Bureau. Zhao Tianlei, you are suspected of leaking state secrets. Please come with us." The crowd instantly exploded.Zhao Tianlei turned pale, staggered back, pointed at Lin Yu, and his voice was trembling: "It's him! It's Lin Yu! He is..." "Is it true? We will investigate clearly." The people from the National Security Bureau stepped forward and said in an unquestionable tone, "Now, please cooperate with our work." In the confusion, Lin Yu looked down at the A4 paper in his hand.The sun shines through the paper, casting strange light and shadow on the back of his hand.Those complex formulas and twisted wing outlines seemed to be undergoing some strange changes in his eyes at this moment, as if there was a layer of data flow invisible to the naked eye flowing on them.He thought of the faint mechanical sound again, the lines of condensation when Su Qingying handed the water, and the flashing red light of Zhao Tianlei's communicator... Is all this really just a jealousy trap of the rich second generation?Su Qingying walked up to him again at some point and gently tugged on the corner of his clothes. Her voice was so low that only the two of them could hear: "Lin Yu, run quickly." Lin Yu looked at her suddenly.The girl's eyes reflected the afternoon sun, as clear as a deep pool, but there were turbulent waves that he couldn't understand."Run?" Lin Yu frowned, "Why?" Su Qingying bit her lip, her eyes quickly glanced at Zhao Tianlei who was being taken away, and then looked at the falling cicadas on the camphor tree in the distance, her voice lowered: "Because... they are coming." Lin Yu followed her gaze and saw in the shadow of the camphor tree, there were several more figures in school uniforms with an air that was clearly not that of a student.They stood there, seemingly watching, but their eyes were as sharp as falcons, and they were looking at him and the A4 paper in his hand calmly.The mechanical sound sounded in his mind again, this time a little clearer: "...the technology deduction system is being bound...the host is detected to be facing a threat...the primary defense mode is activated..." Lin Yu's heart suddenly shrank.He clenched the paper in his hand, and felt the cold touch of the paper on his fingertips, but there was also a subtle vibration.The trap of the bet seems to have just begun.And he has no way out.

江南市的午后，蝉鸣像被拧到最大音量的收音机，在香樟树枝叶间此起彼伏。篮球场的塑胶地面被晒得发软，泛起一层油亮的光，反射着高三（7）班女生们此起彼伏的尖叫——不是为了灌篮，而是为了赵天雷那双踩在限量版aj上的脚，此刻正以一种嚣张的姿态，横跨在林宇面前的水泥分界线上。“林宇，敢不敢接招？”赵天雷晃了晃手里的牛皮纸信封，百元大钞的边角从封口探出来，像挑逗猎物的红布。他身后站着三个跟班，其中一个正用手机直播，镜头刻意扫过林宇洗得发白的校服袖口，又迅速切回赵天雷嘴角那抹不容错辨的轻蔑。林宇刚跑完三千米体能测试，汗水顺着额角滑进眼窝，刺得他眯起眼。他弯腰撑着膝盖喘气，余光瞥见苏清影抱着两瓶冰镇矿泉水穿过人群，白色的裙摆被风扬起时，露出纤细脚踝上若隐若现的红绳——那是上周他在古玩市场帮她淘到的，据说是用三星堆遗址附近的桑蚕丝织成。“没空，”林宇直起身，接过苏清影递来的水，拧开瓶盖时，瓶口凝结的水珠滴在手腕上，“下午还有物理模拟考。”“呵，模拟考？”赵天雷嗤笑一声，往前逼近半步。他身上的古龙水味混合着阳光晒出的汗气，形成一种极具压迫感的气息，“我这题，比你那破模拟考有意思多了。看见没？”他扬了扬信封，“里面三道题，你要能在午休结束前答出来，我赵天雷明天升旗台喊你三声爹，外加这沓钱全归你。”围观的人群发出低低的惊呼。那沓钞票厚得像块砖，至少有五位数。“如果我答不出来呢？”林宇拧瓶盖的手顿了顿，矿泉水瓶壁上的冷凝水正沿着指缝往下淌。“答不出来？”赵天雷像是听到了什么笑话，夸张地张开双臂，“那你就离苏清影远点，以后见了我绕着走。怎么样，敢不敢赌？”他说话时，袖口不经意间滑落，露出一截军用通讯器的黑色边缘，上面闪烁的红光快得像摩斯密码。林宇想起早自习时瞥见的鞋底碎纸，“绝密·六代机”那几个字像针一样扎在记忆里。苏清影轻轻拽了拽林宇的袖子，冰凉的指尖隔着布料传来温度：“别理他，快考试了。”她的声音很轻，却带着不易察觉的紧张，手里另一瓶水的瓶身布满水珠，那些水珠汇聚成的纹路，竟和林宇昨晚在《自然》子刊上看到的某种纳米结构示意图惊人地相似。林宇的心猛地一跳。他知道赵天雷嫉妒自己和苏清影走得近，但这次的赌约透着一股不同寻常的狠劲。赵天雷家族在军方的势力他略有耳闻，难道那些碎纸……“怎么？不敢了？”赵天雷见林宇迟疑，语气更带挑衅，“我就知道，穷鬼家的孩子，也就配埋头啃书本，真遇到点‘高级货’就傻眼了。”这句话像根刺，扎进林宇心里。他不是在乎钱，也不是怕赵天雷，而是突然意识到，这个赌约可能不止是意气之争。他抬眼看向赵天雷，对方瞳孔里闪烁着一种近乎疯狂的期待，仿佛笃定他一定会接下这个陷阱。“好，我赌。”林宇的声音不大，却清晰地穿过嘈杂的人声。苏清影的手猛地收紧，矿泉水瓶发出轻微的挤压声。赵天雷脸上的笑容瞬间凝固了一瞬，随即又变得更加灿烂：“够种！来人，把‘题’给林同学呈上！”跟班嬉皮笑脸地递过信封。林宇接过来时，指尖触到纸张边缘异常光滑的质感——那是被化学试剂擦拭过的痕迹。他不动声色地翻开，里面只有一张a4纸，正面印着三组复杂的流体力学公式，配图是一个扭曲的机翼轮廓，尾翼部分的夹角标注着奇怪的角度：114.5°。“这是……附加题？”林宇皱起眉。这些公式远超高考范围，更像是某种航空动力学的理论模型，但推导过程中有几处明显的逻辑断层，像是故意留下的破绽。“怎么？看不懂？”赵天雷抱着胳膊，一副胜券在握的样子，“我就说嘛，给你本天书也白搭……”他的话没说完，林宇突然伸出手指，点在公式末端的一个参数上：“这里，雷诺数的计算有误。而且这个机翼模型，”他顿了顿，目光扫过扭曲的翼尖，“如果按照这个角度设计，亚音速巡航时升力系数会骤降，根本不可能稳定飞行。”空气瞬间安静下来。赵天雷脸上的笑容僵住了，连直播的跟班都忘了操作手机。苏清影惊讶地看着林宇，她知道林宇物理好，但没想到他能一眼看出这些连老师都未必涉及的问题。“你……你胡说什么！”赵天雷的声音有些发虚，“这是我找的奥赛题，你懂个屁！”林宇没理他，目光落在纸边被擦改的水印位置。虽然痕迹很淡，但在阳光下仍能看到“科学院内部资料”的模糊字样。他心里一沉，果然和那些碎纸有关。赵天雷这是想干什么？用国家机密来设局？“是不是胡说，算一下就知道了。”林宇抬起头，眼神平静却带着一股锐利，“不过我有个条件。”“你还想提条件？”赵天雷像是被戳中了痛处，语气又变得嚣张起来。“如果我答出来，”林宇的目光扫过赵天雷，最后落在他袖口的通讯器上，“你要告诉我，这道题的真正来源。”赵天雷的瞳孔猛地一缩。周围的空气仿佛凝固了，蝉鸣声都变得遥远。他没想到林宇会提出这样的条件，这已经超出了一个高中生的正常反应。难道这小子发现了什么？“你管那么多干嘛！”赵天雷强作镇定，“答出来自然告诉你，答不出来就给我滚远点！”就在这时，苏清影突然往前一步，将另一瓶水递给赵天雷：“赵同学，天气热，喝口水吧。”她的表情很自然，笑容甜美，但递水的动作却让瓶盖不小心碰到了赵天雷的手腕。“滚！谁要喝你的水！”赵天雷像是被烫到一样猛地挥手，矿泉水瓶摔在地上，溅起的水花打湿了林宇的裤脚。林宇弯腰去捡瓶子，指尖触到冰凉的瓶身时，突然愣住了。瓶身上的冷凝水已经汇成几道水流，其中一道恰好沿着瓶身的弧度蜿蜒而下，在阳光下折射出奇异的光泽——那形状，分明就是纸上机翼模型的侧视图，而水流交汇的节点，正是他刚才指出的那个错误参数位置。怎么会这么巧？林宇猛地抬起头，看向苏清影。女孩的眼神清澈，脸上带着恰到好处的尴尬：“对不起，我不是故意的……”但林宇注意到，她垂在身侧的手指，正快速地敲击着裙摆，那节奏，像是在输入某种代码。

“少废话！到底答不答？”赵天雷不耐烦地催促，通讯器的红光闪烁得更快了，几乎变成了常亮。林宇深吸一口气，将矿泉水瓶放在地上。阳光照在a4纸上，那些复杂的公式仿佛活了过来，在他眼中逐渐分解、重组。他想起早自习时赵天雷鞋底的碎纸，想起王教授讲课时偶尔走神提到的“应龙计划”，想起苏清影脚踝上那根来自三星堆的红绳……一个荒谬却又似乎合理的念头在他脑中形成。“可以。”林宇拿起那张纸，指尖在被擦改的水印处轻轻划过，“不过我需要笔和纸。”赵天雷像是松了口气，示意跟班去拿。林宇接过笔和草稿本，目光再次落在那组流体力学公式上。这一次，他没有去看那些表面的推导，而是试图寻找隐藏在错误之下的真相。突然，他发现其中一个变量的下标写法很奇怪，像是某种特定的编码。他尝试着将字母替换成数字，再按照矩阵排列——“等等！”苏清影突然轻呼一声，“林宇，你的手……”林宇低头，看到自己握着笔的手指正在不受控制地颤抖，笔尖在草稿纸上画出一个扭曲的符号，那符号的形状，竟和纸上机翼模型的尾翼夹角一模一样：114.5°。与此同时，赵天雷袖口的通讯器突然发出一声极轻微的蜂鸣，红光闪烁了三下，然后熄灭了。赵天雷的脸色瞬间变得惨白。他猛地转身，对着直播的跟班吼道：“关了！快关了！”但已经晚了。林宇看着草稿纸上那个自动生成的符号，脑海中突然响起一个极其微弱的机械音，快得像错觉：“……检测到异常科技参数……正在扫描……”他猛地抬头，看向赵天雷。对方眼神慌乱，正试图抢夺他手中的纸张。而苏清影不知何时已经退到了人群边缘，她看着林宇，眼神里充满了复杂的情绪，有担忧，有急切，还有一丝难以察觉的……期待。“想抢？”林宇手腕一翻，将纸张护在身后，“赵天雷，你还没告诉我，这题到底是从哪来的？”赵天雷的脸涨得通红，像是被逼到绝境的野兽。他环顾四周，发现围观的同学都在用异样的眼光看着他，直播的手机还在对着他。他突然像是下定了决心，冷笑一声：“好，我告诉你！这题……”他的话没说完，篮球场入口处突然传来一阵急促的脚步声。几个穿着便衣的成年人快步走来，为首的那个亮出证件，声音低沉而有力：“我们是国安局的。赵天雷，你涉嫌泄露国家机密，请跟我们走一趟。”人群瞬间炸开了锅。赵天雷脸色煞白，踉跄着后退一步，指着林宇，声音都在发抖：“是他！是林宇！他才是……”“是不是，我们会调查清楚。”国安局的人上前一步，语气不容置疑，“现在，请你配合我们的工作。”混乱中，林宇低头看向手中的a4纸。阳光透过纸张，在他手背上投下奇异的光影。那些复杂的公式和扭曲的机翼轮廓，此刻在他眼中似乎正在发生某种奇妙的变化，仿佛有一层肉眼看不见的数据流正在上面流淌。他又想起那个微弱的机械音，想起苏清影递水时冷凝水的纹路，想起赵天雷通讯器闪烁的红光……这一切，真的只是一个富二代的嫉妒陷阱吗？苏清影不知何时又走到了他身边，轻轻拽了拽他的衣角，声音低得只有两人能听见：“林宇，快跑。”林宇猛地看向她。女孩的眼睛里映着午后的阳光，清澈得像一汪深潭，却又藏着他看不懂的惊涛骇浪。“跑？”林宇皱眉，“为什么？”苏清影咬了咬嘴唇，目光快速扫过正在被带走的赵天雷，又看向远处香樟树上正在落下的蝉蜕，声音压得更低：“因为……他们来了。”林宇顺着她的目光看去，只见香樟树的阴影里，不知何时多了几个穿着校服、却带着明显不属于学生气质的身影。他们站在那里，看似在围观，眼神却像鹰隼一样锐利，正不动声色地打量着他，以及他手中的那张a4纸。机械音再次在脑海中响起，这一次清晰了一些：“……科技推演系统绑定中……检测到宿主面临威胁……启动初级防御模式……”林宇的心脏猛地一缩。他握紧了手中的纸，指尖传来纸张冰凉的触感，却又隐隐带着一丝微不可察的震动。赌约的陷阱，似乎才刚刚开始。而他，已经没有退路了。
